name: itambox
description: IT Asset Management System — static assets build pipeline

scripts.build:scss: sass static/src/styles/itambox.scss static/dist/itambox.css && postcss static/dist/itambox.css -o static/dist/itambox.css
scripts.build:all: npm run build:scss && npm run build:vendor && npm run build
scripts.openapi-client-smoke: npm run openapi:generate && tsc -p tests/openapi_client/tsconfig.json && node tests/openapi_client/.build/smoke.js
scripts.pretest:unit: esbuild static/src/scan-gate.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=tests/js/.build/scan-gate.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild static/src/scanner.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=tests/js/.build/scanner.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild static/src/scan-basket.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=tests/js/.build/scan-basket.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild static/src/audit-basket.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=tests/js/.build/audit-basket.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild static/src/boost-guard.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=tests/js/.build/boost-guard.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild static/src/specification-editor.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=tests/js/.build/specification-editor.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild static/src/dashboard-charts.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=tests/js/.build/dashboard-charts.mjs --log-level=warning
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/js/scan-gate.test.mjs tests/js/scanner-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/js/scanner-markup.test.mjs tests/js/basket-runtime.test.mjs tests/js/report-designer.test.mjs tests/js/boost-guard.test.mjs tests/js/object-detail-refresh.test.mjs tests/js/i18n-catalog.test.mjs tests/js/specification-editor.test.mjs tests/js/form-submit-loading.test.mjs tests/js/form-dirty.test.mjs tests/js/dashboard-charts.test.mjs
